ns2:course.label: Journalism Proseminar
ns2:course.description: Introduction to scholarship and research in journalism and mass communication examining theoretical approaches to the meanings, uses, and effects of mass media in society; discussion of media freedom and accountability; humanistic and social scientific contributions to understanding mass communication. Prerequisite: Consent of department.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Journalism major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
